$comment: Per-versionGroup BLOCKER reasons for .syncpackrc.json. Keys match the `label` field exactly. Enforced by scripts/check-syncpack-reasons.ts. Lives in a sidecar because syncpack's config schema rejects unknown fields.
A non-workspace consumer must use a file: BLOCKER: the wildcard rule below is correct for WORKSPACES, where `*` resolves to the local copy through the workspace graph. private/account is a SUBMODULE and is not in package.json's `workspaces`, so there is no graph for `*` to resolve through -- it must say `file:../../packages/shared`, and demanding `*` there would break the build rather than tidy it. This is the one group that CANNOT be satisfied as written, which is why it is an exception rather than a converged version. Added 2026-09-03 when `source` was widened to bring the submodule under the pins at all; before that every versionGroup silently stopped at the submodule boundary.
Ensure consistent dependency versions ac: BLOCKER: sameRange policy for prod+dev deps is a global consistency rule, not a pin; ensures cross-workspace ranges never diverge (no per-dep reason applies)
Pin @types/node to latest: BLOCKER: @types/node major must match the Node engine (22.x); v25+ targets Node 25 APIs we do not ship and would introduce unused type surface
Pin i18next for CLI: BLOCKER: i18next is pinned so any future workspace that adopts it stays on the CLI’s line; divergent copies fragment translation key resolution at runtime
Pin the OpenTelemetry 0.x line in lockst: BLOCKER: every 0.x OTel package must move together; mixing lines splits @opentelemetry/core into incompatible copies and breaks span export at runtime. THE PIN USED TO COVER 3 OF 9 -- exporter-trace, sdk-node and resources only -- so api-logs, exporter-logs, exporter-metrics, sdk-logs, core and sdk-metrics were free to drift, INCLUDING the very package the reason names as the thing that splits. A check:deps upgrade moving core alone would have sailed through check:version. Swept 2026-09-03 after a stop-gate judge asked whether the siblings had been searched for. SCOPE LIMIT, stated so this pin does not overclaim: syncpack's default source is package.json's `workspaces`, and private/account is a SUBMODULE, not a workspace. So these pins govern packages/* only, and account's identical OTel ranges are held in step BY HAND. Widening `source` was measured 2026-09-03 and surfaces three unrelated pre-existing divergences (the file: dependency on packages/shared cannot satisfy the wildcard rule, @types/node ^25.5.1 vs the ^22.20.0 pin, and a ^7.0.2/^6.0.3 split), so it is its own change rather than a rider on this one.
Pin the OpenTelemetry 2.x line in lockst: BLOCKER: the 2.x peers (core, resources, sdk-metrics) move with the 0.x line above and with each other; a major-line mismatch between them is the same core split. The earlier reason also claimed later lines force protobufjs 8.x which @grpc/proto-loader rejects -- probed 2026-09-03 and FALSE here: @grpc/proto-loader@0.8.1 resolves protobufjs@7.6.6 under 0.222. Retired rather than left standing as a hazard nobody re-checks.
Pin vite-tsconfig-paths to latest: BLOCKER: vite-tsconfig-paths 6.0.x is required for Vite 6 compatibility; older 5.x silently breaks path alias resolution at build time
Workspace dependencies should use wildca: BLOCKER: cross-workspace @rediacc/* deps must resolve to the local workspace copy via '*'; any fixed version would break the workspace graph. Scoped to workspaces in practice: private/account is carved out by the group above, because a non-workspace consumer has no workspace graph for `*` to resolve through.
